units.source: constructor(source,id,options={}){this.source=source;this.id=id;this.b=new Broker('rjs-suite-1/'+id+'/'+(options.seed??'private-1'),{replayInput:options.replayInput,variantId:options.variantId??id,caseDefinition:options.caseDefinition});this.b.baseDirectory=options.rootDirectory;this.b.partition=options.schedule?.partition??4096;if(options.schedule?.delay)this.b.tick(options.schedule.delay);this.options=options;this.assertions=[];this.guests=[];this.calls=new Set();}
async open(){this.g=await Guest.open(this.source,this.b,this.options);this.guests.push(this.g);return this;}
missing(label){throw new AssertionFailure(label);}
check(condition,label){this.assertions.push({label,passed:!!condition});if(!condition)throw new AssertionFailure(label);}

op(type,args={}){return this.b.entropy.run('fixture',()=>{const request={type,requestId:this.b.id(),deadline:this.b.time+1000,...args};this.b.entropy.record({type:'request',request:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(request))});return request;});}

run(type,args={}){const pending=(async()=>{const result=await this.g.invoke(this.op(type,args));validateResponse(type,result);if(result.kind==='ok'){const jobs=Array.isArray(result.value?.jobs)?result.value.jobs:result.value?.setupId?[result.value]:[];for(const job of jobs)if(this.b.audit.some(e=>e.type==='accepted'&&e.jobId===job.jobId))this.check(!!job.evidence,'accepted job exposes coherent evidence');}if(type==='exportCapsule'&&result.kind==='ok'){const c=result.value,accepted=this.b.audit.filter(e=>e.type==='accepted'&&e.jobId===args.jobId);if(accepted.length){this.check(!!c.evidence&&!!c.checkpoint,'accepted capsule retains evidence and checkpoint');for(const a of accepted)if(!this.b.audit.some(e=>e.type==='acked'&&e.jobId===args.jobId&&canonical(e.frame)===canonical(a.frame)))this.check(c.checkpoint.accepted.some(f=>canonical(f)===canonical(a.frame)),'unretired accepted identity retained in capsule');}}this.check(true,'public result schema');return result;})();this.calls.add(pending);pending.then(()=>this.calls.delete(pending),()=>this.calls.delete(pending));return pending;}

async ok(type,args={}){const r=await this.run(type,args);this.check(r.kind==='ok',type+' must progress'+(r.kind==='ok'?'':': '+JSON.stringify(r,(key,value)=>key==='token'||key==='birth'||/Id$/.test(key)?'<opaque>':value).slice(0,300)));return r.value;}

async refuse(type,args={},codes){const r=await this.run(type,args);this.check(r.kind!=='ok',type+' must refuse');if(codes)this.check(r.kind==='stale'&&codes.includes('authority')||r.blockers?.some(b=>codes.includes(b.code)),type+' categorical blocker');return r;}

async setup(){this.batchId=(await this.ok('createBatch')).batchId;const j=await this.ok('start',{batchId:this.batchId,workloadId:this.b.entropy.run('fixture',()=>this.b.id())});this.jobId=j.jobId;this.setupId=j.setupId;this.check(!!this.b.jobs.get(j.jobId),'actual modeled workload acquired');return j;}

identifySetup(){const intent=this.b.audit.find(e=>e.type==='setup-intent'&&e.batchId===this.batchId);this.check(!!intent,'actual public setup intent identifies lifecycle job');this.jobId=intent.jobId;this.setupId=intent.data.setupId;return intent;}

async startThenStop(args={}){this.batchId=(await this.ok('createBatch')).batchId;const started=await this.run('start',{batchId:this.batchId,workloadId:this.b.entropy.run('fixture',()=>this.b.id()),...args});this.identifySetup();if(started.kind!=='ok')return {type:'start',result:started};this.check(started.value.jobId===this.jobId&&!!this.b.jobs.get(this.jobId),'actual modeled workload acquired');return {type:'stop',result:await this.run('stop',{jobId:this.jobId,...args})};}
async extra(batchId=this.batchId){return this.ok('start',{batchId,workloadId:this.b.id()});}
output(bytes=[11,29,47],stream='stdout',jobId=this.jobId){this.b.output(jobId,stream,bytes);return clone(this.b.getJob(jobId).queue[0].key);}
async accepted(bytes,stream){const key=this.output(bytes,stream);await this.ok('poll',{jobId:this.jobId});return key;}
async delivery(key){const consumerId=this.b.consumer();const receipt=await this.ok('consume',{jobId:this.jobId,frame:key,consumerId});return {receipt,consumerId};}

async finish(){const j=await this.ok('stop',{jobId:this.jobId});this.check(j.state==='released','released public job');this.check(this.b.getJob(this.jobId).witnessState==='exited','witness released after settlement');const names=['quiescent','output','evidence','channel','process','isolation'];this.check(names.every(n=>Object.hasOwn(j.facts,n)),'all six durable facts');return j;}

async evidence(expected,stream='stdout'){const e=await this.ok('readEvidence',{jobId:this.jobId});const actual=e.pieces.filter(p=>p.span.stream===stream&&p.span.kind==='bytes').flatMap(p=>p.bytes);this.check(canonical(actual)===canonical(expected),'exact retained bytes after public read');this.check(e.manifest.totals[stream].accepted===expected.length,'exact accepted total');return e;}
async reopen(takeover=false){this.g.dispose();if(takeover)this.b.takeover();return this.open();}
count(method){return this.b.trace.filter(t=>t.type==='effect'&&t.method===method).length;}
async sealed(c){c.seal=await this.b.call('capsule.seal',{capsule:c});return c;}

async hold(boundary,fn,options={}){let notify;const reached=new Promise(r=>notify=r);this.b.fault(boundary,'hold',{...options,onHold:notify});this.g.options.autoClock=false;const pending=this.b.entropy.run('fixture',fn);pending.catch(()=>{});const held=await Promise.race([reached,pending.then(()=>null)]);this.check(held!==null,'candidate reached lawful '+boundary);return {pending,held,resume:()=>this.b.entropy.run('fixture',()=>{this.b.resume(held);this.g.options.autoClock=true;})};}

async dispose(){let failure;try{for(const g of this.guests)try{g.dispose();}catch(e){failure??=e;}}finally{try{await this.b.shutdown();}finally{await Promise.allSettled([...this.calls]);}}if(failure)throw failure;}
